body.p: After . Owns src/xslt_key.c, src/function_library_xslt.c (a part named only by XSLT compilation), tests/xslt_key_test.c. xsl:key and fn:key (index per document and key, built on first use, composite, collation), document, current, system-property, available-system-properties, function-available, element-available, type-available, unparsed-entity-uri/-public-id, current-output-uri, snapshot, copy-of, apply-templates as a function if the draft keeps it. Done when fn-key, document, system-property, function-available, snapshot, copy-of ≥ 85%. Done 2026-10-17 (): src/xslt_key.c with src/xslt_key_internal.h, src/function_library_xslt.c, tests/xslt_key_test.c; the evaluation memo (src/evaluator.c), the current item in lowering, and patterns without re-selection (src/xslt_pattern.c). Scratch harness: key 75/91, document 64/98, system-property 20/23, snapshot 7/19, copy-of 3/8 of applicable cases; most of the rest need xsl:function (4.12), xsl:sort (4.9) or stylesheet parameters. fn:apply-templates and current-output-uri are left.
